raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Severe floods, landslides and earthquakes damage newly built roads and tourism facilities, reducing accessibility and safety.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Integrate climate‑resilient design (drainage, slope stabilization, retaining walls) and conduct geotechnical risk assessments before construction; establish rapid‑response maintenance fund.",
      "evidence": "Section 60‑61: climate hazards include flooding, landslides, seismic activity; designs include drainage, slope stabilization."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Delays in recruitment of key PIU staff (financial, technical, environmental) impede project start‑up and fiduciary compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare detailed TORs early, launch parallel recruitment drives, and use interim consultants to cover critical functions until permanent staff are hired.",
      "evidence": "Section 62: delayed recruitment of FM staff identified as FM risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Budget allocation and execution delays at national and regional levels postpone disbursements and construction milestones.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Activate budget allocation immediately after loan signing; set up a joint monitoring calendar with MEF and GORE; use advance disbursement method with clear milestones.",
      "evidence": "Section 62: budget allocation and execution delays noted as FM risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Insufficient coordination among ministries, municipalities and private sector leads to fragmented implementation and duplicated efforts.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Operationalize the Project Steering Committee and Consultative Committee with clear terms of reference; require signed Interinstitutional Agreements before any activity starts.",
      "evidence": "Section on Institutional Arrangements – Interinstitutional Agreement and Committee establishment."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Inadequate community and indigenous peoples consultation may trigger protests or legal challenges, delaying works.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Stakeholder Engagement Plan within 90 days, secure Free, Prior and Informed Consent where required, and maintain a grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Legal covenants: requirement to prepare Stakeholder Engagement Plan; SEA/SH Action Plan."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Sexual exploitation, abuse or harassment incidents at tourism sites could damage project reputation and deter visitors.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce the SEA/SH Action Plan, train all staff and local service providers on prevention, and establish a confidential reporting hotline.",
      "evidence": "Section 21: SEA and SH action plan to address sexual exploitation and harassment risks."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Technical design errors or sub‑standard construction could result in premature failure of roads and water‑sanitation assets.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Adopt rigorous third‑party engineering reviews, enforce World Bank procurement standards, and require performance‑based contracts with warranty clauses.",
      "evidence": "Section 36‑37: specifications include road safety, drainage, slope stabilization; procurement follows WB regulations."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Private sector investment (PPP, Obras por Impuestos) may not materialize, limiting economic multiplier effects.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a clear investment pipeline, provide fiscal incentives, and use the World Bank’s facilitation role to match investors with ready‑to‑build assets.",
      "evidence": "Section 23‑24: private investment expected; Obras por Impuestos mechanism described."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Tourism demand may not grow as projected, reducing expected job creation and revenue.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust destination marketing (Component 3), monitor visitor trends quarterly, and adjust promotion strategy to target emerging markets.",
      "evidence": "Section 40‑41: marketing plan to boost arrivals; demand projections in Section 54."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Gender gaps in employment may persist if women are not effectively included in training and business opportunities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Target capacity‑building activities to women’s associations, set a minimum quota for women‑led enterprises in procurement, and track gender employment indicators.",
      "evidence": "Section 33‑34: women‑specific capacity building; indicator for women employment percentage."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Legal disputes over land ownership or heritage site protection could halt construction.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure all Interinstitutional Agreements and land titles before works commence; involve SERNANP and Ministry of Culture early to obtain necessary permits.",
      "evidence": "Section on Interinstitutional Agreement obligations; Section 6 mentions multiple agencies with jurisdiction."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Inadequate operation and maintenance (O&M) plans may lead to rapid degradation of roads and water‑sanitation facilities after hand‑over.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop detailed O&M manuals, train local authorities on asset management, and allocate a dedicated maintenance fund within the PIU budget.",
      "evidence": "Section 15‑16: maintenance arrangements mentioned; O&M arrangements required."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Procurement delays due to unfamiliarity with World Bank procedures could push back project timelines.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct intensive procurement training for GORE’s logistics office, use the Project Procurement Strategy Document as a guide, and engage a World Bank procurement specialist for oversight.",
      "evidence": "Section 63‑64: procurement follows WB regulations; GORE lacks experience with WB‑financed projects."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Health centre construction in Yura may face contractor shortages or equipment delivery delays, limiting health service improvements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Pre‑qualify multiple contractors, secure equipment supply contracts with penalty clauses for late delivery, and monitor progress through monthly PIU reports.",
      "evidence": "Section 38: Yura health centre construction listed under Subcomponent 2.3."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Reforestation and forest‑fire prevention activities may be undermined by illegal logging or insufficient community participation.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Engage local forest‑user groups in monitoring, provide alternative livelihood incentives, and coordinate with SERNANP for enforcement.",
      "evidence": "Section 38‑40: reforestation of Bosque de Queñua and forest fire prevention measures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Political instability or changes in regional leadership could reduce commitment to the project and affect funding flows.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Formalize commitments through legally binding Cooperation and Interinstitutional Agreements; maintain high‑level political champions in the Steering Committee.",
      "evidence": "Section on Legal Covenants and Steering Committee composition."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Inaccurate financial reporting or accounting errors may trigger audit findings and delay subsequent disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Use Peru’s SIAF system for all transactions, conduct quarterly internal audits, and provide staff with World Bank FM training.",
      "evidence": "Section 62‑63: FM risk of inaccurate accounting; use of SIAF and independent audits."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Insufficient data collection for M&E (e.g., visitor surveys, grievance tracking) could limit ability to demonstrate results.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated M&E unit within the PIU, adopt digital data collection tools, and set clear reporting schedules aligned with indicator definitions.",
      "evidence": "Section 49‑50: PIU responsible for M&E; need for complementary mechanisms."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Climate‑induced extreme weather during construction may cause work stoppages and increase costs.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Build weather‑contingency buffers into the construction schedule, secure insurance for public assets, and prioritize works in lower‑risk windows.",
      "evidence": "Section 60‑61: climate hazards identified; adaptation measures include resilient design."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Failure to achieve the planned increase in lodging arrivals could undermine the projected economic return (NPV, ERR).",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Tie marketing activities to measurable targets, conduct periodic market‑demand reviews, and adjust investment sequencing to prioritize high‑impact attractions.",
      "evidence": "Section 54‑55: economic analysis relies on increased arrivals; PDO indicator on lodging arrivals."
    }
  ]
}
